subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

_______ repeated warnings, he still comes late.
solution:
The correct answer is **"In Spite of ".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ** In spite of** means regardless of something or not affected by something.
 
• **In spite of **is used with negative instances when contradicting a
